messages:
Maria Chen: quick thread — SigmaCorp renewal for 50 seats (Q3). Quote sent yesterday. Customer asking for a 9-month term + their internal vendor code on the PO. Procurement is holding signature until vendor code + revised SOW. cc @Harry for pricing

Harry Patel: thanks — did we already agree on 9mo pricing? Sales had proposed a prorated 9mo at ~75% of annual. Need Priya to confirm from finance.

Priya Gomez: finance: we can accept 9mo but we need to record as 12mo ARR with a credit note for accounting. Prefer net-30 payment terms. Also they must include our vendor code in the PO.

Rajesh Iyer: SE here — I can update the SOW to reflect 9mo/prorated pricing and leave support unchanged. Will attach updated SOW ~30m. Any specific billing lines to preserve?

Maria Chen: customer wants same support sku, no feature changes. They requested billing email set to billing@sigma-corp.com and PO description "Dedicated - 50 seats".

Billing Team: billing: our invoices should go to billing@redwood.ai (not their internal). Also vendor code is RDW-4521 — please ensure PO includes Vendor Code: RDW-4521.

Harry Patel: updated quote with 9mo prorate and sent to Elaine (procurement). Quote ID Q-7884. Elaine replied: wants a signature link (prefers PandaDoc) instead of emailed PDF. Ok to use PandaDoc?

LegalOps Bot: legal: standard renewal SOW can be sent via PandaDoc, no special T&Cs required for 9mo. If customer requests contract language changes, loop legal.

Maria Chen: Raj — can you publish the updated SOW to PandaDoc with vendor code + billing email included? I will follow up with Elaine for PO number.

Rajesh Iyer: done — uploaded SOW to PandaDoc and enabled signature routing. Link: https://panda.co/rdw-sigma-7884. I also added a PO example in the doc: 

```
PO#: 2026-556
Vendor: Redwood Inference, Inc
Vendor Code: RDW-4521
Billing Email: billing@redwood.ai
Amount: $120,000
Term: 9 months (prorated from annual)
```

Maria Chen: Elaine just replied — procurement will issue PO by EOD once vendor code and tax ID are on the doc. She also asked for our tax ID. I'll DM billing for tax info.

Billing Team: tax id is 12-3456789 — sending to Maria now. :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: plan recap: Raj publishes PandaDoc (done), Harry confirms quote lines (done), Priya to confirm net-30 vs net-60 (customer asked net-60), I will chase Elaine for PO number and attach tax ID.

Priya Gomez: finance update: we can accept net-60 as a one-off for this customer but need exec approval. I've pinged Sarah (CFO) for signoff.

Maria Chen: thanks all. will update once PO arrives. if Sarah signs off on net-60 we finalize as-is; otherwise we'll push net-30 fallback. :handshake:
